title: Think with Grounding: Curriculum Reinforced Reasoning with Video Grounding for Long Video Understanding

evidence.quote: To address this problem, we propose Video-TwG, a curriculum reinforced framework where we employ a novel Think-with- Grounding paradigm, which equips video LLMs with explicit ondemand video grounding behavior during reasoning, without relying on complex auxiliary modules or costly supervised fine-tuning reasoning traces.
